name: std::fsetpos
intro:
Sets the file position indicator and the multibyte parsing state (if any) for the C file stream stream according to the value pointed to by pos.

Besides establishing new parse state and position, a call to this function undoes the effects of std::ungetc and clears the end-of-file state, if it is set.

If a read or write error occurs, the error indicator (std::ferror) for the stream is set.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
stream

 -

  file stream to modify


  pos

 -

  pointer to a fpos_t object obtained from std::fgetpos called on a stream associated with the same file

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 upon success, nonzero value otherwise. Also, sets errno on failure.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: After seeking to a non-end position in a wide stream, the next call to any output function may render the remainder of the file undefined, e.g. by outputting a multibyte sequence of a different length.

summary: Sets the file position indicator and the multibyte parsing state (if any) for the C file stream stream according to the value pointed to by pos.
